note: Forested headland park north of Trinidad (renamed from Patrick's Point), with sheer bluffs over the Pacific, Agate Beach below and a reconstructed Yurok village. RVs use the Abalone and Agate loops; Penn Creek is tent-only. Only Agate stays open through the winter (Abalone and Penn Creek showed out of season on ReserveCalifornia through late May 2027). The 15-night limit is per calendar year. Bear lockers at Agate only. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page, info sheet, campground PDF and ReserveCalifornia catalog read. $35 confirmed; rig 31 -> 30 ft (RC lengths), 83 RV sites; showers/water/dump confirmed; 15 nights a year; Agate year-round, Abalone/Penn seasonal. Coastal walk kept (park forest to the bluff, no road between).
